analysis.executiveSummary: Big Balder Brand aims to acquire 24-year-old cornerstone quarterback Drake Maye (90.3 C-AVI / 90.9 D-AVI) from Southside Savages, anchoring the proposal with Jayden Daniels (73.1 C-AVI / 85.0 D-AVI). In a straight 1-for-1 swap, Southside Savages (Retooling) lacks strategic incentive to downgrade from a top-tier dynasty QB without receiving secondary compensation. However, by expanding the proposal to include young running back Omarion Hampton (55.2 C-AVI / 85.0 D-AVI), Big Balder Brand creates a balanced multi-position package that resolves Southside's RB2 void while securing an elite long-term QB centerpiece for Big Balder Brand's rebuild trajectory.

submitted.summary: The submitted 1-for-1 proposal enables Big Balder Brand to secure a premier Tier-1 dynasty quarterback in Drake Maye (+17.2 C-AVI / +5.9 D-AVI over Daniels). However, Southside Savages receives no secondary assets or draft liquidity to justify stepping down from Maye to Daniels.
